source_record.source_review_rationale: Prefixing an allowed action preserves future equality, so each allowed action descends and the coarsest stable refinement proof is sound. The A/B commutation iff clause requires A,B among those allowed actions; no stochastic-bisimulation extension follows.

deterministic_future_readout.domain: Finite nonempty S and finite alphabet U of deterministic total maps F_u:S->S, with fixed readout r:S->Y.
deterministic_future_readout.words: Every finite common action word w in U*, including the empty word, is allowed. F_w denotes sequential execution of that word.
deterministic_future_readout.equivalence: s~t iff r(F_w(s))=r(F_w(t)) for every w in U*.
deterministic_future_readout.named_actions: A and B in the quotient-commutation statement are among the admitted F_u. An additional action outside U may be used only after separately proving it preserves ~.
deterministic_future_readout.sizes: n=|S| and c=|r(S)|. Proper partition refinement increases the number of classes and gives the bound n-c.
deterministic_future_readout.limits: This deterministic behavioral quotient and action menu is a selected view. No probabilistic-bisimulation extension or experiential equivalence is asserted.
